7-Zip source subset used by the Inno plugin

Upstream:  https://github.com/ip7z/7zip
Tag:       26.05
Commit:    b88c6bc09339de32f7d18bbab900686b244f42ba (2026-10-21)
License:   DOC/License.txt (GNU LGPL 2.1 or later, with public-domain and
           BSD-licensed files; see ../../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and
           DOC/copying.txt (full text of the GNU LGPL 2.1)

Every file in this folder is a byte-for-byte copy of the upstream file at the
same path. Do not edit them: changes belong in ../../src, ../../tests or
../../CMakeLists.txt.

How the subset was chosen
-------------------------
1. The 7-Zip sources that ../../CMakeLists.txt compiles
   (SEVENZIP_COMMON_SOURCES, SEVENZIP_PLUGIN_SOURCES, SEVENZIP_CLIENT_SOURCES;
   CPP/Common/MyWindows.cpp only outside Windows). The plugin exports follow
   upstream's single-format plugin CPP/7zip/Archive/7z/makefile:
   ArchiveExports.cpp, DllExports2.cpp and CPP/7zip/Archive/Archive.def, plus
   CodecExports.cpp and CreateCoder.cpp, which needs FilterCoder.cpp. The
   handler decodes Inno Setup data with C/LzmaDec.c and C/Lzma2Dec.c (LZMA,
   LZMA2), CPP/7zip/Compress/DeflateDecoder.cpp and ZlibDecoder.cpp (zlib)
   and BZip2Decoder.cpp with BZip2Crc.cpp (bzip2), plus the files that these
   decoders need (BitlDecoder.cpp, LzOutWindow.cpp, CPP/7zip/Common/InBuffer.cpp
   and OutBuffer.cpp). The plugin is built with Z7_ST, so the multithreaded
   BZip2 decoder code is not needed. The client uses the files that upstream
   CPP/7zip/UI/Client7z uses.
2. Every header that these files, ../../src and ../../tests/client include,
   directly or indirectly, on Windows (MSVC, MinGW) and Linux (GCC).
   C/Threads.h is left out: only an "#if 0" block in CPP/Common/MyCom.h
   includes it.
3. DOC/License.txt and DOC/copying.txt.

How to update
-------------
1. In a clone of the upstream repository, check out the new tag.
2. Copy every file listed by "git ls-files C CPP DOC" in this folder from the
   new tag, for example (in this folder, bash):
     for f in $(git ls-files C CPP DOC); do
       git -C <clone> show <tag>:"$f" > "$f"
     done
3. Build with GCC, MinGW (x86_64 and i686) and MSVC (x64 and Win32); all of
   them treat warnings as errors. Add the files that new includes need (the
   unchanged upstream copies) and remove the files that are no longer used.
4. Update the tag and commit above, then replace the old version everywhere
   else in the repository; "git grep -nF -e <old tag> -e <old tag without
   the dot>" lists the places: the docs, tests/client/InnoClient.cpp,
   SEVENZIP_TAG in .github/scripts/setup-inno-tools.sh, and in
   .github/workflows/inno-plugin.yml the release URL and the names and SHA-256
   of the Windows installers ("gh release view <tag> --repo ip7z/7zip
   --json assets" lists the digests).
5. Run tests/run_tests.py and the CI workflow (.github/workflows/inno-plugin.yml),
   which also tests with the official 7-Zip release.
